entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Where do you think you're going, Joker?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mona went that way. Come on, we need[n]to hurry and chase after him!
entries.uk: Мона подався туди. Ну ж бо, треба[n]поквапитися й наздогнати його!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look! There he is!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We need to go after him and talk things[n]through.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmph. I won't let myself get caught by[n]someone like you!
entries.uk: Гм. Таким, як ви, я не дамся!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... We are facing a car here. Does it[n]not seem somewhat reckless to chase[n]him on foot?
entries.uk: Гм... Перед нами автомобіль.[n]Чи не здається вам дещо необачним[n]гнатися за ним пішки?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You sure give up easy.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There are dead ends all over this floor.[n]We can do this if we manage to corner[n]him in one.
entries.uk: На цьому поверсі повно глухих кутів.[n]Упораємося, якщо заженемо його[n]в один із них.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mwehehe, you're trapped now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmph, how naïve. You really think you've[n]captured me?
entries.uk: Гм, які ж ви наївні.[n]Справді думаєте, що спіймали мене?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shit, look out!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sheesh, what would he have done if he[n]ran us over!?
entries.uk: Блін, а що б він робив,[n]якби нас переїхав?!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Stop complaining and let's get after[n]him again!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Wonderful, we have reached him!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mona! Will you listen!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shut up! I've got nothing to talk about[n]with you guys!
entries.uk: Замовкніть! Мені нема про що[n]з вами говорити!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ngh, not again...!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There will be no end at this rate...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What was that!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It came from over there! Let's go take[n]a look!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tch, that idiot crashed.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yup. Mona, are you okay!?
